resources.string: Install packages from the VESC package store: board firmware add-ons, displays, lights, BMS support

A package is a LispBM program, often with settings and a screen, that runs on the controller. Installing one replaces whatever package or script is on it now. Packages for other hardware are hidden unless you show them.
A library, not a package to install
Other packages and scripts import it. In the LispBM editor, import it with pkg::name@package.vescpkg.
The package\'s own check says it doesn\'t suit this controller. Installed anyway, it may not start or may misbehave.
The package\'s check uses something this app can\'t evaluate, so it may or may not suit this controller. Read its description first.
Contains a LispBM program that runs on the controller.
Contains a screen for VESC Tool. This app doesn\'t run those screens; the package\'s settings appear under Settings when it registers them.
Contains a full-screen app for VESC Tool. This app doesn\'t run those screens; the package\'s settings appear under Settings when it registers them.

The controller\'s current package or LispBM script and its VESC Tool screen are erased and replaced. Keep it powered until the install finishes; an interrupted install leaves it without a program until you install again. Motor settings are untouched.
The store comes from the VESC Project server over an unencrypted connection, as in VESC Tool.
The package says it doesn\'t suit this controller.
It runs now. Reconnect to see settings or screens the package adds.
The LispBM program and the VESC Tool screen were erased.
Erases the controller\'s LispBM program and its VESC Tool screen. Settings the package stored stay until another package replaces them.
